title: Book Hope Town Haven Cottage | Rosemary Beach Cottage | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Hope Town Haven Cottage in Rosemary Beach has it all! Enjoy a new plunge pool, summer kitchen, balcony, and open living space! Click to book this Rosemary Beach cottage today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Access to all 4 Rosemary Beach community pools and 4 complimentary adult bikes. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

FULLY RENOVATED FALL 2025 – this property is now a beautifully refreshed coastal retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach which was on the 2025 Christmas Tour of Homes. This stunning property received a major facelift in Fall 2025, transforming it from vintage charm to an elegant and relaxing coastal vibe. Ideally located on the south side of 30A, a short 3-minute walk to the beach and steps from restaurants, shops, tennis courts, and the fitness center, it offers the perfect blend of luxury, location, and laid-back comfort.

Living up to it’s name, Hope Town Haven Cottage is designed for gathering, entertaining, and relaxing in coastal style. It has a spacious open living area with a large gourmet kitchen featuring a gas stove & oven, ample counter space, fully equipped with everything needed to host and entertain family and friends. The inviting dining area has seating for 8 to 10 with additional space on the kitchen island with four Serena & Lily swivel chairs, which are ideal for children. As you dine, you can enjoy the lively activity along the boardwalk and 30A.

The first floor also features two spacious seating areas complete with peacock paver floors with abundant natural light and crisp white slipcovered couches surrounding a large 65” smart TV. An additional seating area with four plush swivel chairs allows for separate entertainment for adults and children. The first floor also includes a twin bunk room with full bath along with a full-size washer & dryer. French doors lead to the beautifully renovated large outdoor living area complete with IPE deck, surrounding an inviting plunge pool, complete with a stainless-steel outdoor kitchen, grill and fire pit. The comfortable outdoor seating and teak wood lounge furniture makes it easy to spend long afternoons swimming, grilling or gathering under the stars in this meticulously landscaped sanctuary. The outdoor space combines coastal charm and modern luxury – a true outdoor oasis for your Rosemary Beach stay.

Ascending to the second floor, you’ll find two master suites with comfortable king beds, ensuite bathrooms, private balconies overlooking the pool and boardwalk with large smart TV’s for your comfort and entertainment. A third upstairs bedroom has 4-beds (twin and queen bunkbeds), perfect for kids or additional guests, along with a sitting area and large 50” smart TV.

Steps from Main Street’s shops and eateries, Hope Town Haven Cottage is the perfect place to spend a family getaway, multi-family retreat or friend’s reunion.

Garage parking with ample adjacent public parking spaces.

DURING SPRING BREAK & SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS FOR 7 OR 14 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY.
